profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Leidos
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: As a software engineer at Leidos, I develop C++ software for complex distributed systems supporting autonomous maritime platforms. My work focuses on enabling reliable communication and coordination between multiple networked components across onboard and remote systems. I contribute to the design, implementation, and integration of high-performance software used in real-time and resource-constrained environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams to support autonomous navigation and mission operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a team of engineers through multiple projects, collaborating with leadership to define product requirements and drive development. Developed software in C++ for AM335x microprocessors, optimizing real-time audio processing and implementing new features for devices like the Aeros Loop Studio and BeatBuddy 2. Built a Node.js web app with an AWS backend to monitor YouTube comments, incorporating AI for sentiment analysis. Enhanced TypeScript software for BeatBuddy devices, adding new features and improving efficiency. Updated the Midi Maestro app to comply with Google Play Store policies. Skilled in software development, real-time audio processing, and full-stack web applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the Next Generation Threat System (NGTS) contract, developing real-time flight simulation software in C++ and Qt to enhance pilot training. Created the Acoustic Gateway program to integrate sonobuoys into exercises, and developed a software router to process real-time environmental data critical to training scenarios. Contributed to interface design documentation and built a plugin for NGTS to provide instructors with precise data and control tools. As part of the network team, I managed diverse network protocols, maintained pipelines, and added features to support customer needs, ensuring seamless communication and functionality for a wide range of users.
